lessons.title: Options Contract Fundamentals
lessons.description: Decode option contract terms, holder rights, writer obligations, multipliers, premium cash flow, and expiration payoff.

lessons.title: Calls and Puts
lessons.description: Compare long and short calls and puts using rights, obligations, payoff charts, breakeven, and maximum risk.

lessons.title: Moneyness
lessons.description: Classify calls and puts as ITM, ATM, or OTM and calculate intrinsic value from stock and strike.

lessons.title: Option Premium
lessons.description: Decompose theoretical option premium into intrinsic and extrinsic value and change core pricing inputs.

lessons.title: Option Chain and Liquidity
lessons.description: Read option-chain fields, quantify bid-ask friction, inspect activity, and evaluate a limit-order selection.

lessons.title: Expiration and Time Decay
lessons.description: Visualize long-option value by days remaining and inspect theoretical theta, intrinsic value, and extrinsic value.

lessons.title: Implied Volatility
lessons.description: Model option-value changes from IV expansion and contraction separately from underlying movement.

lessons.title: Delta and Gamma
lessons.description: Compare delta-only and delta-plus-gamma estimates with full theoretical repricing and visualize delta across stock prices.

lessons.title: Theta and Vega
lessons.description: Apply time and IV shocks, compare theta-plus-vega estimates with full repricing, and visualize volatility-dependent decay.

lessons.title: Long Calls and Long Puts
lessons.description: Plan long calls and puts with expiration breakeven, premium risk, modeled early-exit value, and payoff charts.

lessons.title: Covered Calls
lessons.description: Build covered calls, compare them with stock-only payoff, and calculate breakeven, maximum profit, and downside risk.

lessons.title: Cash-Secured Puts
lessons.description: Calculate cash reservation, effective purchase price, payoff, maximum premium profit, and downside risk for cash-secured puts.

lessons.title: Vertical Debit Spreads
lessons.description: Construct bull call and bear put debit spreads and calculate debit, breakeven, maximum loss, and maximum profit.

lessons.title: Vertical Credit Spreads
lessons.description: Construct bull put and bear call credit spreads and calculate credit, breakeven, maximum profit, and maximum loss.

lessons.title: Exercise, Assignment, and Expiration
lessons.description: Simulate expiration outcomes, exercise and assignment obligations, resulting shares, and broker-handling risks.

lessons.title: Options Trade Planning
lessons.description: Score a complete options plan across thesis, strategy fit, timing, spread, risk budget, event exposure, and exit rules.
